emergencyStopBanner.banner: {{agent}} is paused, but {{count}} run(s) are still finishing. They keep running until they finish on their own.
emergencyStopBanner.confirmDescription: The run(s) are cancelled immediately with the same code a pause-cancellation uses, so no recovery hold appears. Work resumes when the agent is resumed. This cannot be undone.
